sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact instruction-tuned release, Essential AI, dense architecture, 8.3B total parameters, tied embeddings, coding/STEM focus, tool use, open weights and Apache 2.0. Native context is 32K; optional 128K extrapolation requires configuration changes. Its later changelog labels the initial version December 8. Fresh October 27 read of both pinned and current full cards confirms 8.3B total and tied embeddings. The explicit Instruct/Base training relationship describes SFT after the same base pretraining; neither card separately reports an active count.

sources.title: Announcing Rnj-1: Building Instruments of Intelligence
sources.evidence: Dated December 5, 2025 and announces both Base and Instruct. Describes an 8B dense Transformer with global attention and YaRN, trained from scratch; discusses coding, mathematics, scientific problem solving and tools. Reopened October 27 and checked the original model comparison image: the table reports benchmark scores and pretraining FLOPs, not active parameters. The Gemma resemblance is architectural; the developer expressly says the model was trained from scratch.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma3ForCausalLM / gemma3_text; 32 full-attention layers, hidden size 4096, intermediate size 16384, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head dimension 128, vocabulary 128256, max_position_embeddings 32768, F32 and YaRN factor 4.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct complete checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Maps exactly 418 learned weight tensors to seven shards. Total tensor payload is 33,242,005,504 bytes. All indexed tensors were matched to bounded shard-header reads.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: Accepts textual system/user/assistant messages and tool definitions; serializes function names and arguments in tool_call tags. No separate thinking mode or reasoning channel is defined.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct Apache License
sources.evidence: Repository license text is Apache License Version 2.0.

sources.title: Official checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Repository creation is December 4, 2025 03:07 UTC; initial checkpoint upload is December 6, 2025 00:37 UTC, which is December 5 in the publisher's US Pacific time zone. Later changes affect documentation and the chat template.

sources.title: December 4 initial repository tree
sources.evidence: The initial December 4 commit contains only .gitattributes, with no model weights or model card; it does not establish model release.

sources.title: Initial checkpoint upload tree
sources.evidence: The December 6 00:37 UTC commit contains the model card, license, configuration, tokenizer, index and all seven weight shards.

sources.title: Later official Rnj-1.5 Instruct card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies Rnj-1.5 as a distinct follow-up to Rnj-1 Instruct, with changed local/global attention and a 160K context window. These newer specifications do not apply to the audited Rnj-1 Instruct. Reopened the complete card October 27 and visually inspected its linked benchmark table. It compares Rnj-1.5, Rnj-1, Qwen, Gemma and GPT-OSS benchmark scores and pretraining FLOPs, with no active-parameter row or convention for Rnj-1.

name.note: Display name matches the exact rnj-1-instruct variant, distinct from Base and Rnj-1.5.

developer.note: Developer explicitly identifies itself in the release and model card.

family.note: Normalized family label for the named Rnj model family.

release_date.note: Use the explicit public announcement date. December 4 is an empty repository creation; the weight upload is December 6 UTC / December 5 Pacific. The current card's December 8 initial-version changelog is later than the announcement.

open_weights.note: Official weights are publicly accessible in seven complete safetensors shards.

license.note: Publisher licenses repository and weights under Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned count: 8,310,501,376 = 525,336,576 tied embedding/head + 6,442,450,944 MLP + 1,342,177,280 attention-projection + 536,576 normalization parameters. All 418 indexed F32 tensors are included; no duplicate lm_head, packed storage, quantization scales or buffers. Publisher rounds to 8.3B (family label 8B). Fresh October 27 exact-card and metadata checks confirm the same revision, nominal total and aggregate; retain the prior precise count without repeating the census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/activated and lineage searches, original/Base cards and later Rnj-1.5 comparisons found no separate active count or developer counting convention. Both original and later image tables were visually checked; their FLOPs and benchmark rows do not define active parameters. Named-base SFT lineage supplies no undisclosed count to inherit, and Gemma-like architecture is not Gemma weight ancestry. Dense total is not copied into this field.

architecture.note: Dense decoder Transformer, Gemma-3-like with global attention, grouped-query attention and YaRN; trained from scratch rather than a Gemma weight derivative.

context_window.note: Default trained/configured context. The optional 131072-token YaRN extrapolation requires edits and reports some regressions; the distinct Rnj-1.5 has a larger window.

modalities.note: Text causal language model and tokenizer; checkpoint includes no image/audio encoders or generation heads.

reasoning.note: Sources describe mathematical/scientific reasoning abilities but do not establish a dedicated reasoning/thinking capability flag. The ordinary chat template alone does not prove the baseline false assertion; clear it.

tool_call.note: Official documentation and template explicitly support function calls.

patch.description: Open-weight 8.31B dense instruction-tuned model trained by Essential AI for code, mathematics, science and tool use.
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint count: 8.310501376B learned parameters, with tied embeddings counted once; the publisher rounds to 8.3B. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. December 5 is the public announcement date; December 4 only created the repository. Context is 32,768 by default; optional 128K YaRN extrapolation requires configuration changes. No dedicated reasoning flag is established by primary evidence.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained the prior exact 8.310501376B total and an undisclosed active count. Fresh searches and reopened original/current cards, named-base evidence, metadata and later Rnj-1.5 comparisons yield no active-count convention. Visually checked original and later benchmark figures; they report scores and FLOPs, not active parameters. Added explicit parameter patches and refreshed evidence while preserving unrelated assessments; no weight shards or repeat census requested.
